svg.desc: REGENESIS CLEANFLOW — Environmental Fate and Remediation Model: question, observables, model and validation. Proposed design; no measured results.
svg.text: B07 / REGENESIS CLEANFLOW — Environmental Fate and Remediation Model
Which documented remediation pathways most reliably reduce total contaminant burden and
toxicity rather than merely removing a monitored parent compound?
Parent/product concentrations, matrix descriptions, abiotic comparisons and reported
dc_i/dt = D_i*laplacian(c_i) - v·grad(c_i) + sum_r(nu_ir*r_r(c)) - k_loss,i*c_i; use a
stoichiometrically balanced reaction network on a molar basis.
Hold out whole studies/matrices; repeated samples from one system are not independent external
Conceptual design • proposed research • full equations, data access and uncertainty in the dossier
